prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Tokyo Chamber of Commerce and Industry (東京商工会議所 - TCCI) member directory?

source.name: Tokyo Chamber of Commerce and Industry (東京商工会議所 - TCCI)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the TCCI member directory by free word with the full company name.
prompts.found_when: A member entry with that name is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search returns no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search is unavailable or only covers Tokyo-registered businesses.
